import bpy,os,json,time
from pathlib import Path
_probe_out=Path(os.environ['WFRL_TEST_OUTPUT']);_probe_tmp=_probe_out/'scratch';_probe_tmp.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
bpy.context.preferences.filepaths.temporary_directory=str(_probe_tmp)
_probe_deadline=time.monotonic()+90
def _finish_validation():
 p=_probe_out/'window-checks.json'
 if p.exists() and json.loads(p.read_text()).get('status') in ('PASS','FAIL'):
  bpy.ops.wm.quit_blender();return None
 if time.monotonic()>_probe_deadline:
  p.write_text(json.dumps({'status':'FAIL','error':'Visible validation timed out'}));bpy.ops.wm.quit_blender();return None
 return .5
bpy.app.timers.register(_finish_validation,first_interval=.5)
